summary: The prompt over-splits around dropped subjects, verb-less trailing fragments, and reporting connectives, breaking pronoun/subject continuity; it also under-splits many long sentences at safe, quality-neutral boundaries like causal '-어서', sequential '-고 나서', opinion markers, and topic-shifting fillers, leaving free latency on the table. Fixes should target boundary placement relative to elided subjects and connective scope rather than banning any specific ending outright.
